text: One evening. <break time="0.8s" /> Her husband came home. <break time="0.8s" /> With a proud look. <break time="0.8s" /> And handed her a large envelope. <break time="0.8s" /> It was an invitation. <break time="0.8s" /> To a grand ball at the Ministry. <break time="0.8s" /> Which he had worked very hard. <break time="0.8s" /> To get. <break time="0.8s" /> Instead of being delighted. <break time="0.8s" /> She threw the invitation. <break time="0.8s" /> On the table and asked. <break time="0.8s" /> What do you want me. <break time="0.8s" /> To do with this. <break time="0.8s" /> I have nothing to wear. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> And two tears ran slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> Down her cheeks. <break time="0.8s" /> Her husband had saved. <break time="0.8s" /> Four hundred francs. <break time="0.8s" /> To buy a gun. <break time="0.8s" /> For hunting with his friends. <break time="0.8s" /> That summer. <break time="0.8s" /> He turned a little pale. <break time="0.8s" /> But he gave her the money. <break time="0.8s" /> For a beautiful dress. <break time="0.8s" /> As the day of the ball. <break time="0.8s" /> Came closer. <break time="0.8s" /> Madame Loisel. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed sad and anxious again. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not have a single jewel to wear. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> I will look like a poor woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Her husband cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Go and see. <break time="0.8s" /> Your friend Madame Forestier. <break time="0.8s" /> And ask her to lend you. <break time="0.8s" /> Some jewels.
